message: The other day, as a storm rolled in, I found myself rifling through my pantry, convinced I was ready for anything Mother Nature could throw at me. I mean, who doesn't have enough canned beans to last a small army? My grandkids rolled their eyes as I explained the importance of being 'gloriously over-prepared.' But honestly, there’s a certain peace in knowing you could survive a week of snow, a hurricane, and maybe a surprise visit from the in-laws. What’s your go-to item for storm prep—canned beans or something more exciting? 🌧️
